title: RequestSnapshot
description: A transaction request snapshot capturing detailed execution information for a single request.

id.description: The internal numeric identifier for the snapshot.

localID.description: The local ID of the snapshot on the originating node.

requestGUID.description: The globally unique identifier for this request snapshot.

summary.description: A summary description of the snapshot.

businessTransactionId.description: The ID of the business transaction this snapshot belongs to.

applicationComponentId.description: The tier ID where this snapshot was captured.

applicationComponentNodeId.description: The node ID where this snapshot was captured.

firstInChain.description: Whether this is the first snapshot in a cross-application call chain.

userExperience.description: The user experience classification for this request.

timeTakenInMilliSecs.description: The total execution time for this request in milliseconds.

serverStartTime.description: The server-side start time in Unix epoch milliseconds.

archived.description: Whether this snapshot has been archived.

URL.description: The URL or entry point for this request.

errorIDs.description: List of error IDs associated with this snapshot.

errorOccured.description: Whether an error occurred during this request.

diagnosticSessionGUID.description: The GUID of the diagnostic session that triggered this snapshot.
